sections.heading: Using BONG
paragraphs: BONG is here for entertainment and inspiration. You may browse the site and use the idea generator for lawful purposes. Do not interfere with the site, bypass its security or misuse its content.

sections.heading: Ideas and history
paragraphs: The generator draws from a fixed collection of ideas. There is no promise that an idea is original, accurate, suitable or available for your intended use. Check important facts and other people’s rights before acting on an idea or publishing it.
Historical entries distinguish BONG’s fictional narration from sourced history. Source links are there for further reading and checking.

sections.heading: $BONG
paragraphs: No official contract address has been published on this site. BONG does not connect wallets or offer purchases or trades. Be cautious with accounts or tokens using the same name, and use only official links published on this site.
BONG content is not financial or investment advice.

sections.heading: Other sites and availability
paragraphs: Linked sites have their own terms and are outside BONG’s control. BONG and its content are provided as available; features may change, pause or be removed.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
paragraphs: You are responsible for how you use an idea or a linked service. To the extent allowed by applicable law, BONG is not responsible for losses caused by relying on ideas, historical summaries, linked sites or impersonator accounts.
